asked.item: Why the visual won't render, stuck at draft

verdict.reason: The request sets isDraft, which the docs say saves without rendering. The docs also say mediaUrl only appears once the status is done.

steps.text: The isDraft field saves the visual as a draft without rendering.
The documented request sends inputs: {}, a prompt, and render: true.
A status of draft is a draft, not a completed render, and mediaUrl and/or imageUrls are only available once the status is done.
